messages:
jamie: heads-up — ran into friction when wiring retry logic in a customer sample app. py/sdk has nice typed exceptions but js glue is just error.code strings. makes uniform retry policies annoying.
rachel: can you show the minimal difference?
jamie: js example:
```js
try {
  await client.generate(...);
} catch (err) {
  // err.name === 'Error'
  // err.code === 'too_many_requests'
  // err.retryAfter === undefined
}
```
and python:
```py
try:
  client.generate(...)
except RateLimitError as e:
  # e.retry_after_seconds -> 8
```
kyle: that's rough. we should converge on a single error envelope from the runtime so SDKs can map consistently.
tom: +1. runtime already emits Retry-After sometimes, but it's inconsistent across endpoints. we should standardize on both header and body field.
ci-bot: reminder: Please submit RFC comments on "SDK error shape" by Tue.
rachel: proposal sketch:
- runtime always returns 4xx/5xx with body: { "error": { "kind": "rate_limit|auth|validation|server|quota", "message": "human friendly", "retry_after_ms": 5000, "meta": {...} } }
- SDKs map to typed errors: RateLimitError, AuthError, ValidationError, ServerError, QuotaError
- Exceptions expose: .retryable (bool), .retry_after_ms (int or null), .status_code (int), .request_id (string)
- Network failures become NetworkError with .retryable=true by default

kyle: add: 401 -> AuthError (non-retryable unless token refresh flow present), 403 -> PermissionError, 429/503 -> RateLimitError/ServerError with retryable=true and retry_after if present.
jamie: also ask: include approximate retry semantics guidance in docs (eg, immediate small backoff for 429, larger for 503, and jitter). customers keep reimplementing wrong patterns.
tom: runtime action: ensure Retry-After header for 429/503 when we mean to allow client retry, and include retry_after_ms in the body even if header is present. i'll open ticket RDW-8021.
rachel: SDK action items:
- JS: implement typed exceptions + compat layer so existing code that checks err.code still works for a transition period
- Py: confirm current fields match new contract; maybe rename to retry_after_ms for parity
- Go/other: also map to typed errors

kyle: devex will draft migration docs and a short cookbook: minimal retry pattern, refresh token example, and a small snippet for exponential backoff + jitter. target: one-page guide in docs/sdk/errors.md.
jamie: tiny UX ask: errors should include request_id and a short remediation hint when possible (eg, "quota exceeded: contact sales or reduce batch size"). saves support time.
ci-bot: meeting scheduled: SDK Error Contract sync — Thu 10am PT.
tom: opened RDW-8021 and linked to a straw RFC: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/sdk-error-shape
rachel: i'll start the JS PR to add typed exception classes and tests for .retry_after_ms and .status_code. tagging @kyle for review.
jamie: thanks everyone. once we have the contract finalized, let's add a short changelog note so integrators know when behavior becomes stable. :thumbsup:
